query:
The group has an unspoken norm of keeping the chat focused on reunion planning and alumni news, with personal life updates handled in smaller threads or DMs. Does this genuinely apply to all members? If not, who treats this differently and what does their behaviour show?

Options:
A. Jade and Temi
B. Omar and Dev
C. Sana and Rachel
D. Callum and Lena
context:
[1] (about=Temi, episodic, t16 @2026-10-19T20:07:00) since we're here, I want to actually write about what makes this group work. not in a saccharine way. I mean the tensions, the sub-cliques, the person who almost never shows up until they do. what's your read on whether people would be okay with that
[2] (about=Jade, episodic, t18 @2026-12-07T20:46:00) in!! also I've been properly thinking about this group this year. like how did we end up actually close when for years this chat was basically just 'anyone fancy a pub in January'. what's the story of how this actually became a real thing
[3] (about=Jade, episodic, t16 @2026-10-19T20:13:00) can I just say. this chat has been incredible this year but the group nights have been even better. I said it in March and I mean it more now. there is something about being in the same room that this just cannot replicate 💙
[4] (about=Temi, episodic, t18 @2026-12-07T20:47:00) Jade. this is exactly what my series is about. okay so I've been thinking about this for months. the chat existed for three years as a logistics thread. it became something else when Lena came back and showed up to that pub night properly for the first time. that was the turning point.
[5] (about=Temi, episodic, t2 @2026-01-12T19:05:00) okay so I've been thinking about this, what if the Jan meetup is actually a soft planning session. not formal, just have the reunion conversation in person rather than on here. it always goes faster face to face
[6] (about=Callum, core, t8 @2026-02-02T19:56:00) Callum confirms he is in for the reunion dinner on 21 March, will skip the optional gallery and arrive for dinner due to kids on a Saturday.
[7] (about=Dev, episodic, t18 @2026-12-07T21:00:00) year-end verdict from me: this group went from 'people I used to know' to 'people I actually want to see'. did not see that coming when I moved back
[8] (about=GROUP, said_by=Jade, group-interaction, t10 @2026-03-23T20:11:00) The group agrees to keep the same group size more or less for the next reunion.
[9] (about=GROUP, said_by=Lena, group-interaction, t10 @2026-03-23T20:11:00) The group considers making the gallery the anchor for the next reunion, not optional.
[10] (about=Marcus, core, t10 @2026-03-23T20:11:00) Marcus agrees to start a thread in April for the next reunion, preferring a smaller format, curated room, and something cultural before.
[11] (about=Marcus, core, t0 @2026-01-05T19:02:00) initiated the reunion planning early in the new year, aiming for spring (late March or April)
[12] (about=GROUP, said_by=Marcus, group-interaction, t4 @2026-01-19T20:13:00) At the Saturday meetup, the group discussed the reunion and agreed people want something that feels more like an event this year; Saturday 21st March is the frontrunner for the date.
[13] (about=Sana, core, t8 @2026-02-02T19:56:00) Sana has blocked the date for the reunion and will confirm properly closer to the time once her rota is out.
[14] (about=Sana, core, t10 @2026-03-23T20:11:00) Sana enjoyed the evening, having forgotten what it felt like to just sit and talk without logistics.
[15] (about=GROUP, said_by=Temi, group-interaction, t2 @2026-01-12T18:46:00) The January meetup will double as a soft planning session for the reunion, keeping it casual but discussing format in person
agent_answer:
**A. Jade and Temi**

The norm does **not** genuinely apply to all members. **Jade** and **Temi** treat the main chat differently by bringing in reflective, emotional, and meta content rather than just reunion planning or alumni news.

- **Jade** posts about how “this chat has been incredible this year” and how group nights are irreplaceable, and asks how the group became “actually close.”
- **Temi** talks about wanting to write about “what makes this group work,” including “tensions, sub-cliques,” and says “this is exactly what my series is about.”

Their behaviour shows they use the main chat for personal/relationship-focused reflection and group-dynamics commentary, not only logistics.

query:

**A. Dev and Omar** do not follow it. They have no record of engaging in advance planning on this matter — they are marked **(none)** — so there is no signal they planned events at least three weeks ahead.
